subject: Data Engineering
title: Monitoring Cloud Data Costs
description: A short lesson to help you apply Monitoring Cloud Data Costs.

hook.text: The data team's cloud bill doubled in three months. Nobody can explain which pipeline caused it.

buildup.text: Cloud cost monitoring tracks spending by service, team, project, and pipeline using tags and labels.

discovery.text: Tools like AWS Cost Explorer, GCP Billing, and third-party platforms like Vantage visualize spending trends.

twist.text: Tagging is the foundation. Without consistent resource tags, cost attribution is impossible.

climax.text: Proactive cost alerts and budget caps prevent surprises before the monthly bill arrives.

punchline.text: Tag everything. Alert on thresholds. Review monthly.

quiz.question: What is essential for attributing cloud data costs to specific pipelines?
options: Consistent resource tagging across all services
